description: Ranks a project's tracked queries by how much a metric changed between the given window and the immediately preceding window of equal length — the biggest gainers and losers. Each row is one tracked query (a single engine + country) with its current position/share/sentiment and the signed trend delta (positive = improved). Sort by one of the trend keys; sortOrder desc = top gainers, asc = top losers. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "which queries moved the most" or "my biggest gains and drops versus last period".

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

sortBy.description: which trend delta to rank by

sortOrder.description: desc for top gainers, asc for top losers

name: get_query_movers
title: Biggest tracked-query movers
